title: DeleteSupport
description: The `delete-support` mutation payload as it travels the wire: internally tagged with `"mutation": "deleteSupport"`, camelCase throughout. Its hard bounds and `x-semio-invariant` entries state exactly the payload-intrinsic breaches `mutations::guards` refuses as `mutation.invariant`, so every such payload fails this schema; refusals that depend on the base (a missing, duplicate or still-referenced target) belong to the diff alone.

mutation.description: The internally tagged discriminator `#[value(tag = "mutation")]` puts on the wire.
